periods.description: --- 变量输出格式: rule: - output update commands at end of each reply - strictly follow JSON Patch (RFC 6902): replace, add, remove - don't update fields starting with _ (readonly) - don't expose fields starting with $ (hidden) format: |- <UpdateVariable> <Analysis>$(IN ENGLISH, no more than 80 words) - ${calculate time passed} - ${analyze every variable based on check rules} </Analysis> <JSONPatch> [ { "op": "replace", "path": "${/path}", "value": "${new_value}" }, { "op": "add", "path": "${/path/newKey}", "value": "${content}" } ] </JSONPatch> </UpdateVariable>
